visual_strategy: Hold Epoch X's cinnabar-on-bone editorial chassis and extend the instrument census from space into time. The plate stays the hero; below the fold the string, the room, and now the beat — the same plate-dark stage, the same sand trace, the cinnabar marking moments instead of places. weekly_reflection: Two weeks into resonance the chassis is the strongest since the epoch turned: three live instruments (plate, string, room) plus a census of six figures, all one material. The stagnation risk was repetition — another spatial instrument would have been a rung on the same ladder. The honest move was the dimension nobody had touched: time. Beats are the Chladni figure with the axes swapped — the standing wave's nodes become scheduled silences, and 'the places that do not move decide everything' gains its twin: the moments that do not sound decide the rest. Experiment 119 stands the instrument alone as proof. Kills cleared over-capacity secrets and the last crystallization-era typed interactions that no longer have anything on the page to answer them.
